observations: body: the line numbers 10 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 162.» (L13) and «p. 163.» (L39) in the right margin; the line number 5 did not print.
body L6: the reference after «praecessionem» is printed (3), where note 2 belongs (note 2 explains the hourly precession; note 3 is called on L34); kept as printed.
body L10: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXI) read «107,10, pro consuemus l. consuescimus»; the printed «consuemus» is kept.
body L13: «eclipsís» is printed with an acute over the last i, a stroke of about 2.7 pt rising to the right in place of the dot; kept as printed.
body L17: the c of «ascendens» is printed broken.
body L36: the hyphen of «docui-» is printed as a point at mid height.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
